segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ אִילָן שֶׁהָיָה מֵיסֵךְ עַל הָאָרֶץ, אִם אֵין גּוּפוֹ גָּבוֹהַּ מִן הָאָרֶץ שְׁלֹשָׁה טְפָחִים — מְטַלְטְלִים תַּחְתָּיו.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to «a tree that was hanging over the ground,» i.e., its branches hung down on all sides like a tent so that it threw a shadow on the ground, «if» the tips of «its branches are no higher than three handbreadths from the ground, one» may «carry under it.» This applies even if the tree is planted in a public domain, as the branches form partitions which turn the enclosed area into a private domain.

segments.he: שׇׁרָשָׁיו גְּבוֹהִים מִן הָאָרֶץ שְׁלֹשָׁה טְפָחִים — לֹא יֵשֵׁב עֲלֵיהֶן.
segments.en: If «its roots» were «three handbreadths higher than the ground, one» may «not sit on them,» as it is prohibited to use a tree on Shabbat. Any part of a tree that is three handbreadths above the ground has the status of a tree with regard to this prohibition.

moves.cueHe: שרשיו גבוהים מן הארץ שלשה טפחים
moves.summary: may not sit on roots three handbreadths high

positions.claim: one may carry under a tree whose branches hang within three handbreadths of the ground
one may not sit on roots three handbreadths above the ground
positions.basis: prohibition of using a tree on Shabbat
